behavior.waiting: Internal stage retained; never allocates or displays question-mark HUD or requires skip click.
behavior.ingredientBank: Each ingredient flag controls price and AH/vendor quantity; default off. Need10 bank5 => buy10 off/buy5 on. No permanent target created.
behavior.vendor: Latest verified typed stock clears opposite flag; unknown/invalid metadata preserves facts. Owned unlimited input retains source; changed stock reprices or invalidates stale budget.
behavior.recipes: Character cache and follow-up snapshot retain profession ID/name, recipe ID/name, reagents, output and yield while profession closed; execution revalidates live owned recipe.
behavior.modernCommodity: Need40 can use one explicit forty-item transaction over price levels; native buy intent remains player initiated.
behavior.modernItem: Result availability is separate from one physical item bought by PlaceBid. Price, private reserve and builtin receipt use physical1; five-charge item contributes pending5 once.
behavior.legacy: One whole listing per player press; typed native generation result, including false, beats stale cache; shown native owner/API fallback handles compatibility namespaces.
behavior.excess: Only legacy ordinary SKUs use stored excess preference. Modern UI hides/disables control; charged SKUs always reject excess. Target9/capacity5 still rounds to two required physical items.
behavior.existingCorruptPending: Old reservations lack safe transaction provenance. Do not globally halve; authoritative mailbox reconciliation/collection remains safe recovery.

native.route: Existing user-native reproduction retained; no Witchcraft/UIForever tool available.
